answers.core: The demand for this feature is widespread enough to justify its addition to the core. And if it isn’t added to the core, most developers who need a stopwatch in their projects wouldn’t be able to benefit from this implementation. Also, a Stopwatch add-on can’t resolve the issue with the widespread usage of delta-based stopwatches for use cases that require real-world accuracy.
answers.workaround: This enhancement will be used often. As mentioned above, a Stopwatch with any functionality beyond calculating elapsed microseconds (pausing, scaling with Engine.time_scale, formatting, etc) will require much more effort than “a few lines” — closer to 200 lines in my implementation.
